integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically via the clipped-gap induction. A finite verifier independently checks full 2-WL partitions for paths of orders 1 through 40; those computations are corroboration rather than a substitute for the proof.
limitations: Specialized to finite simple paths and standard ordered-pair 2-WL from atomic equality/edge/nonedge colors; no claim for arbitrary trees or other initial colorings.
title: Exact 2-WL stabilization depth of path graphs
